bullets: ZOOM. Nurture with a spin! Zoom into Paradise! Turn the dial to take care of your Tama. Zoom from cell to space for traditional nurturing play - clean the poop, feed them delicious food and make them feel better! Play new mini games and nurturing activities and shop in the new LAB MODE.

CHARACTERS. Raise more than 50,000 Tamas. Depending on the environment and the way you take care of your Tama, you can grow over 50 different characters in 12 species, with over 30 new Tamas. Plus, BREED play creates more Tamas by bringing parent's genes to the next generation.

CONNECT. Connect with friend's device directly to see how your Tamas interact - is it a good match or a bad match? And, now, when you connect, you can play games with or against your friend! ** Please note that the connect mini-game is not available in "Tamagotchi Paradise - Pink Land / Blue Water / Purple Sky / Jade Forest.” **
THREE FIELDS. Start in the Tropics field and unlock the Glacier and Forest fields for different play and Tamas. Plus, purchase are expansions to expand the field!
AND MORE. The Orange Tropics device has a pretty pink shell with orange top, dial and buttons
Choose from nine languages (English, French, Spanish, German, Portuguese, Italian, Chinese, Korean and Japanese). Requires 2-AAA batteries (not included).

reviews.name: A Keyes
reviews.title: Better than the original
reviews.body: Super cute and fun. My daughter loves it! You can have more than one pet, and when or if they die they turn into a star in the sky. All the fun of the original plus so much more to do. The battery life isnt bad, but it isn't good either. I'd still get it again, Definitely worth it 👍🏼

reviews.name: Daniela
reviews.title: So Cute and Fun!
reviews.body: I’m really happy with my Tamagotchi! It’s such a fun little device and brings back so many nostalgic memories. The design is adorable, and it’s easy to use and carry around. I love checking on my virtual pet throughout the day and taking care of it.It’s a cute addition to my collection and also makes a great gift. If you enjoy Tamagotchi or nostalgic toys, I definitely recommend it!

reviews.name: Rivka Chala
reviews.title: Amazing toy! My child loves it!
reviews.body: The Tamagotchi Paradise is an amazing and high-quality toy! The purple and pink design looks beautiful and very colorful. The new zoom-in function with the wheel dial is incredibly unique and makes taking care of the character so much fun. My child absolutely loves it and plays with it all day. Highly recommended for any Tamagotchi fan!

bullets: MAKE STORYTIME MAGICAL & SCREEN-FREE WITH THIS PINK PROJECTOR - Project illustrated storybook pages on the wall or ceiling while soothing narration plays, so kids can watch, listen, and read along at their own pace. Creates a calm, low-stimulation experience perfect for bedtime wind-down, quiet time, and a screen-free break from tablets and TV. A wonderful gift for toddler boys and girls.

INCLUDES 5 PROJECTED READ-ALOUD STORIES & 5 SONGS - The starter Owl character features about 30 minutes of classic songs and stories like Little Red Riding Hood, Goldilocks, and Itsy Bitsy Spider. Luna creates an immersive reading experience with 750+ beautiful projected images to 8’ — 20x more images than competitors! Boosts early literacy and imagination, watch listen and read along.
SOOTHING NIGHTLIGHT WITH MUSIC & AUTO SHUT‑OFF - Gentle glow and calming music for up to 15 minutes before powering off automatically, helping establish a peaceful bedtime routine.

EASY FOR KIDS, BACKED BY A 1-YEAR WARRANTY – Designed for little hands, Luna is simple enough for kids to use independently or with a parent: just put a character on top, press a button, and let the magic begin. Powered by 4 AA batteries (not included) or the included USB cable plugged into a power source – Luna has no internal rechargeable battery, so if using USB power, keep it plugged in during play. EXPAND YOUR LUNA LIBRARY - Additional Luna content characters (sold separately) bring new stories and songs featuring beloved franchises like Sesame Street, John Deere Kids, Daniel Tiger and more. Each character offers 30+ minutes of screen-free storytelling and songs to grow with your child’s interests.

reviews.name: Erica Rosado
reviews.title: Great product, my kids love it !
reviews.body: My kids love it and the quality is great. However when I first initially bought it we had it for about a month then it just stopped working, I did everything to try to get it to work but it just didn’t. I contacted customer support and thankfully sent me a new one with no issues.

reviews.name: Devani
reviews.title: Easy to use, brings you back to simpler times
reviews.body: It’s definitely a cool thing to have. Gives us that nostalgic feeling from our childhood. Something to have while snuggling up with our baby. Stories aren’t rushed and they’re classics. Vibrant images as well.

reviews.name: Amazon Customer
reviews.title: Great for nights
reviews.body: My daughter loves this, but it’s no longer working with the batteries, which was preferred so she can control it in her crib and the other option is to have it plugged in. Didn’t have it that long before it started to malfunction with batteries.
